translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Fenaiuw Wunuunun Ammwen Ngaeniir Rhooa Affayeo

“Oawpwe aefaenniy pwe oawsoapw feeori feoffeeoriun aaemi tiwegin faaen meseer aeremas pwe repwe weri meeta oawwa feeori. Pwe aere oawfeeori taeppen minneen nge oawsoapw pwigi paniuwaemi me reen minna Semaemi wooai naaeng.

“Iwe aere oawfang ngaeni erhai man affayeo eew aegiaeg, oawsoapw aeni oangonongon minne oawwa feeori, oawte taeppeer rhooa oatupwutupw kka refeeori noan wutteer Jews me pwan wooan ennap. Refeeori minneen pwe aeremas repwe ngonotiir. Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe ra moannon pwigi paniuweer.
Ngaere oawwa fang ngaeni erhai man affayeo eew meeta, oawpwe feeori noan mwoanomwoan, pwe rhooan oaromw mwo nge resoapw giuneei wunuunun.
Ina nge epwe mwoanomwoan meeta oawwa feeori. Nge Semaemi a weri minne oawwa feeori noan mwoanomwoan epwe aesefaaeni ngaenigaemi paniuwaenin.
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Maeipin

“Igine oawpwe maeipin, oawsoapw taeppeer rhooa oatupwutupw kkewe. Re tipaeni repwe gaen iutae nge ra maeipin me noan wutteer Jews me noan oapwugopwugon ennap, pwe aeremas repwe weriir. Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe ra moann me pwigi paniuweer.

Ngaere aaemi oawpwe maeipin, oawpwe toonong noan aaemi sengkin, oawwa ttiy noa asam nge oawwa maeipin ngaeni Semaemi ina oawse weri. Iwe, Semaemi epwe weri minikka oawwa feeori noan mwoanomwoan epwe aesefaaeni ngaenigaemi paniuwaenin.

“Ngaere oaw maeipin, oawsoapw aeyae towunepaen petenaen kkepas kka esooar faan, taeppeer re Gentiles regaen feeori minneei, pwe re maengiy pwe aar deus repwe aiussaening aar maeipin pwe iga e igin faeremworh.
Oawsoapw taeppeer, pwe Semaemi a fasiun giuneei meeta aaemi mwerhaen weni mmwaen iga aaemi oawpwe tingoar ngaeni.
Iwe, epwe ieei wunuunun aaemi oawpwe maeipin:

content.text: aemwo epwe ssoar minna itoamw ina e santus,
wooan feoniufan wunuunun rhag noan naaeng.
Ngaennegemaem mwongoi raaeneei aeipwe mwongo igina.
wunuunun pwan aemaem aeiya saenetiir noa rhooakkena re monofit ngaenigemaem.
nge wopwe aengesagemaem saengi Man Aenneew we.
[Pwe oamw rhag mweoi me manaman me nning esoapw iug. Amen.]’

content: “Aere oawpwe saeneti noa aar aeremas monofit, ina nge Semaemi wooai naaeng epwe pwan saeneti noa aaemi monofit.
Nge aere oawsoapw saeneti noa aar aeremas monofit, Semaemi esoapw pwan saeneti noa aaemi monofit.
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Aecchigipin

“Ngaere oawpwe aecchigipin, oawsoapw mas affayeo taeppeer rhooa oatupwutupw kkewe regaen feeori. Ra mas affayeo noa, pwe aeremas repwe giuneei pwe ra aecchigipin. Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe ra faer moannon pwigi paniuweer.
Ngaere aaemi oaw aecchigipin, oawpwe woraes me kkomwuuw rhimwemi,

pwe aeremas resoapw giuneei pwe oawwa aecchigipin, pwe aaen manna rhag Semaemi ina oawse weri minne e giuneei. Nge Semaemi iwe e giuneei minne oawwa feeori noan mwoanomwoan epwe aesefaaeni ngaenigaemi paniuwaenin.
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Wenepwuwarh me Wooai Naaeng
“Oawsoapw iseis wiinaemi wooai soanop, pwe manepwur me iyow repwe fereei noa, nge rhooa mwoarho repwe fereei nong nge ra pirifa.
Nge oawpwe faer iseis wenepwuwaemi wooai naaeng, iga manepwur me iyow resoapw mmwenen fereei, nge rhooa mwoarho resoapw mmwenen fereei nong nge ra pirifa.
Pwe pwunnomi epwe no rhag iga wenepwuwaemi eno ee.
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Seremaen Oanong
“Maas eweei rhag oappwunon oanong. Pwe aere mesoamw effat, oanongan noa oanongoamw epwe seram.
Ngaere mesoamw ese ffat, oanongan noa oanongoamw epwe rorhappiung. Pwe aere minna aesseremaen oanongoamw ese seram, nge epwe ifa mwo rorhappiungiun minna nee tipaemi!
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Deus me Minikka Pisaegirh

“Ese mmwen erhai epwe engaang ngaeniir riiurhai maasta. Ina epwe oapwuta erhai, nge aerhaengi iwe erhai, me ngaere epwe mwamwaai ngaeni erhai, nge a aenneew ngaeni erhai. Ese mmwen oawpwe engaangappag ngaeni Deus me senaapiy.

“Ina minne ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe oawsoapw aiunaeng reen mwongo me rhaan pwe oawpwe menaw reen, ngaere mengaagiun oanongaemi. Pwe meeta, ese rhaeng rhag menaw me mmwaen mwongo? Nge ese rhaeng noa rhag oanong me mmwaen mengaag?

Oaw pipiir man aeniaen: Rese foat faiun waniwan, me giniiy uwaan, pwe repwe seoiyeoninong noan soko, nge Semaemi wooai naaeng efang rhag aeneer. Pwe meeta, ese temoag noa egius rhaengimi memmweer man aeniaen?
Eyor neeimi epwe mmwenen enaenaei noa egius menewan reen aan aiunaeng?
“Meeta oaw aiunaeng reen mengaag reen? Oawfan ngaeni peeon waniwan wunuunun aar menawtae: rese engaang, nge rese pwan ffeeor mengaagiiur.
Nge ngaang ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe igiwe mwo king Solomon e menaw iwe erhai man ssow wiinan nge esooar mengaagiun ne enning noa me mmwaen peeon waniwan kaan.

Pwe Deus minne aememmengaagiur fetinen neeiin waniwan — fetin kka eyor igina, nge resoapw nonoa naiu, pwe ra figaeg noa newumw. Pwe meeta, Deus esoapw mmwenen aememmengaagiugaemi? Me gaen mwittiginen aaemi niugiuniug!
“Ieei minne oawsoapw aiunaeng nge aepesa pwe, ‘Meeta sipwe mwongo?’ aere ‘Meeta sipwe iuniumi?’ aere ‘Meeta sipwe memmengaag?’
(Pwe ikkaan minikka re Gentiles retip mwaramwar reen.) Semaemi wooai naaeng e giuneei pwe oawpwe ammweneni oanongaen minikkeei.
Nge oawpwe gommwaen giutta minna Mweoiun Deus me minikkena e mwerhaen pwe oawpwe feeori, iwe, iiy epwe ngaennegaemi oanongaen minikkeei.
Ieei minne oawsoapw aiunaengiy naiu reen, pwe naiu epwe sipegin feeori aiunaengin. Esooar ipitan sipwe oatomoga noa aiunaengiy noan eraaen me eraaen.

footnotes.text: Petenan eei nge e soano noan aekkaew petenan kka e foatofoat noan kkepesaen Greek.
aere: Eyor erhai me neeimi ne epwe mmwen aenaenaeinoa egius taegiasan oanongan reen aan aiunaeng?
